facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports ARTCI is the regulator receiving data protection complaints and running inspections under the 2013 law, and keeps the national register of data protection correspondents.
Agence Ecofin reports ARTCI had pronounced no financial sanction despite 210 complaints and 18 inspections.
ARTCI, styled the protection authority, announced a national census and compliance assessment under Law 2013-450, with OKTO Technologies collecting data from 26 January to 25 May 2026.

The Autorite de protection's decisions register lists decision no. 2024-0996 of 16 January 2024 giving a warning and formal notice to the ministry METFPA and the company Kaydan Groupe on data protection.
The Autorite de protection's own register lists its normative, authorisation and sanction decisions from 2016 to January 2024 under loi no. 2013-450.
